If your boots don’t work out, you have several options:

Return for a refund:

Free returns within 30 days of purchase/order.
Boots must be unworn, in original condition/packaging, tried on only on carpet.
Start a return via our Returns Portal and follow the prompts using your order number and email.
Once received, refunds are typically processed in about 8 business days, plus up to 10 business days for your bank to post the credit.

Order a different pair:

We don’t offer exchanges, but you can return your boots for a refund and then place a new order for a different size or style at any time.

If you just placed your order and it’s not shipped yet:

You have 60 minutes after placing the order to cancel it via the link in your confirmation email or in My Account. After that window, you’ll need to wait for delivery and then process a return.

These are your available options if the boots or order don’t work out for you.
